name: Historic Centre of Rome, the Properties of the Holy See in that City Enjoying Extraterritorial Rights and San Paolo Fuori le Mura
description: Rome, in Italy, was founded according to legend by Romulus and Remus in 753 BC, and it later ruled an empire before becoming the centre of the Christian world. Its protected core stretches to the 17th-century walls and packs in the Forums, the Pantheon, Trajan's Column and the imperial mausoleums beside papal churches and palaces. Some Vatican-owned properties here enjoy embassy-style extraterritorial status.
